verdict.rationale: Docs confirm serverless endpoints hosting 100+ open-source models with per-token pricing, no provisioning latency, and OpenAI-compatible API, plus prototyping-to-dedicated-hardware continuity, supporting a broad open-weight catalog. However no evidence explicitly enumerates specific family names (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS) beyond a single example model ID (gemma) in a CLI snippet, and community sentiment is mixed on overall platform standing versus rivals. missing for 10: explicit model-family list/coverage table naming Llama/Qwen/DeepSeek/GPT-OSS, independent hands-on confirmation of catalog breadth.
